title: Let Children Hear the Mighty Deeds
description: Let Children Hear the Mighty Deeds in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 4 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Isaac Watts, first published in 1719. The tune, LEA, is by James Lea Summers. This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: Let child-ren hear the might-y deeds Which God per-formed of old; Which_ in our young-er years we saw, And_ which our fa-thers told.

lines: Let children hear the mighty deeds
Which in our younger years we saw,
He bids us make His glories known,
His works of pow'r and grace;
And we'll convey His wonders down
Our lips shall tell them to our sons,
May teach them to their heirs.
Thus shall they learn in God alone
That they may ne'er forget His work
